name: Fatal Error
storyline:
"Another construct once told me that our purpose is to provide answers. Sadly, the answer this time may very well end our purpose." - Tactical Artificial Intelligence Defender (TAC-AID)

Since cycles immemorial, the Mainframe has defined the existence of the Motherboard and her faithful digital constructs. Now, a sinister viral invasion has begun. As the Mainframe falls under siege, the Motherboard activates an untested yet powerful anti-virus construct: you.
summary: Fatal Error is a real-time strategy game on the digital battlefields of a computer world under attack. With your TAC-AID and advanced programming, you must eliminate all threats to the Mainframe and take the fight to the viruses. Discover an abstract world of limitless potential…and lurking dangers.
